quoted_tweet.author: Teslaconomics
quoted_tweet.text:
I trust Grok Bot with ALL my finances. 

Now, all 5 of my credit cards are saved in the vault.

People think I’m crazy to do so... but if you think about it, people hand their credit card to a random waiter all the time and watch it disappear into the back. 

For me, I'd rather have mine secured by the smartest AI in the world.

This is why I do it. 

1/ One text to buy anything. I bought my kids 2 Garmin watches, a DribbleUp smart ball and an Ollyball without ever opening a website.

2/ Flights and hotels booked for me. No digging for a card, no typing numbers into 6 checkout pages.

3/ Amazon orders handled with one text.

4/ I just say "put it on the United card" or "use the Apple Card" and it does.

FYI the bot never sees the full number or the security code. It securely remembers them, and I specifically approve what gets bought.

Once, you add your cards once, you’ll never have to pull out your wallet again.

This is how everyone is going to live soon imo.

I’ve left Anthropic after more than a year of working on Claude Code and seeing it scale larger than I ever imagined.

I have really loved working at Ant and believe deeply in the mission, and most of all, the idea of a race to the top.

The idea that if we work hard and responsibly, we can raise the bar and inspire others to great outcomes. And if we all push each other to be better, things can be radically good. I will carry the spirit of this with me forever.

My colleagues at Anthropic are the most talented, thoughtful, competent, and earnest people I have ever met. I am glad they are at the wheel and trust them deeply.

To the community on X, thank you for everything. You’ve made this the most fun (and sometimes stressful) job I’ve ever had.

For me, it is time for a bit of a break before diving into something new.

If you want more excellent Claude Code content, you should follow @addyosmani , @lydiahallie, @_catwu, @ClaudeDevs  and of course @bcherny who started it all.
